approach.call_type: Rules on title + attendee email domains.
approach.themes: Keyword taxonomy over title, summary, provided topics, and early transcript. Optional OpenAI JSON refine if OPENAI_API_KEY is set.
approach.sentiment: Duration-weighted polarity of utterance sentimentType. Customer-side only on support/external so Aegis politeness does not wash out the signal.

takeaways: Support calls: customer-side sentiment averages -0.45 across 31 meetings (duration-weighted utterance polarity).
External calls: customer-side sentiment averages 0.20 across 39 meetings (duration-weighted utterance polarity).
Detect-tagged calls sit 0.47 below the rest of the corpus. That gap is the outage/reliability plotline showing up in customer language, not just in engineering war rooms.
Support is more negative than account-management calls. AM conversations can lag the ticket queue — sales may still hear a calm QBR while support is already absorbing an outage.
70 calls recover in the last third of the transcript; 1 deteriorate. Recovery is a coaching cue (workaround landed). Deterioration is a process cue (no path to resolution).
Weakest customer-sentiment week: 2026-03-09 (support, n=7). Use that week as the incident overlay when walking the panel through Detect/Identity spikes.
